items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: we went down and made a record with Lena Horne.

ctx.x: He was putting together a new band. His lawyer called me up. What was his name? Andy Weinberg. He called up and he said, "Artie's getting this band together, and he would like you to give him a call." So we got together, we went down and made a record before we got the band together, we went down and made a record with Lena Horne.
